description: U-AInSPECT Project: Bridge Use Case dataset EUCENTRE Foundation is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Martina Mandirola, chiara casarotti (European Centre for Training and Research in Earthquake Engineering). UAS-based bridge inspection dataset, with AI-processed damage detection results and 3D reconstruction outputs from rural infrastructure monitoring. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is U-AInSPECT Project. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
